title: Uncooked Ham's Cooked Foods DEMO
description: This is the demo for my datapack, Uncooked Ham's More Foods. the full version will be released later.
body:
THIS IS JUST A DEMO FOR THE FULL DATAPACK. THIS DATAPACK WILL BE FULLY UPLOADED LATER IN TIME.

This datapack adds 14 new food items to Minecraft.
If you have any bugs, suggestions, or overall feedback, comment it down below.

There are 3 categories of food.
Cooked
Prepared
Ingredient

Cooked represents items that are smelted in a furnace or smoker.
Prepared represents items that are crafted in a crafting table.
Ingredient represents items that can (or will) be used in crafting recipes for other items.



Cooked

Cooked Carrot - Simply a cooked carrot. Restores 7 hunger points and 5 saturation points.

Side Effects - None


Cooked Pufferfish - Simply a cooked pufferfish. Restores 5 hunger points and 7 saturation points.

Side Effects - None


Zombie Jerky - You need to cook a piece of rotten flesh to get this. Restores 5 hunger points and 6 saturation points.

Side Effects - Strength 2 for 15 seconds.


Prepared

Sweet Berry Pie - The crafting recipe is 1 Sweet Berry, 1 Egg (of any type), and 1 Sugar (or Caramel Ball). Restores 8 hunger points and 4.8 saturation points. (can be crafted with a leaf block to have a leaf on the texture)

Side Effects - None


Glow Berry Pie - The crafting recipe is 1 Glow Berry, 1 Egg (of any type), and 1 Sugar (or Caramel Ball). Restores 8 hunger points and 4.8 saturation points. (can be crafted with a leaf block to have a leaf on the texture)

Side Effects - None


Baguette - The crafting recipe is 3 bread. Restores 5 hunger points and 6 saturation points.

Side Effects - None


Caramel Apple - The crafting recipe is one apple surrounded by eight Caramel Balls. Restores 4 hunger points and 2.4 saturation points.

Side Effects - Speed 1 for 15 seconds.




Ingredient

Butter - The crafting recipe is 1 milk bucket (or curdled milk bucket).
Side Effects - None

Chocolate Bar - The crafting recipe is a bucket of milk (or curdled milk) surrounded by cocoa beans. Restores 2 hunger points and 0.4 saturation points.
Side Effects - A chance to give you speed 1, speed 2, or poison 3.

Cheese - The crafting recipe is 4 milk (or curdled milk). Restores 5 hunger points and 6 saturation points.
Side Effects - None

Curdled Milk Bucket - To get it, you need to cook a bucket of milk.
Side Effects - Slowness 10, Poison 10, Blindness 10, Hunger 10, and Nausea 10.

Baguette - The crafting recipe is 3 bread. Restores 5 hunger points and 6 saturation points.
Side Effects - None

Caramel Ball - To get it, you need to cook sugar. Restores 1 hunger point and 10 saturation points.
Side Effects ﻿- Night Vision 1 and Speed 1.
